This is one informal equipment-swap account, not a controlled test.

scoringEvidence.decision: Retain all six scores as low-confidence editorial estimates. A 157W user anecdote directionally supports stability and turn performance for an experienced freeride-focused rider, but its size, season and conditions do not match the seed's 157 standard. A second, season-context 162 cm equipment-swap note describes easier handling versus an AMICSS DNA-Ti but insufficient ice grip; its width variant, board season label, tune and exposure are uncertain, and the owner cited possible edge-tune influence. The official event list only proves 25/26 narrow demo availability. Float and park have no direct ride evidence. Value is a Japan-MSRP FX conversion and not a China-market price. No external rating or description is converted numerically into the site's six dimensions.
scoringEvidence.confidence: Low across all six dimensions; target-period evidence now includes one informal 162 cm swap ride with unspecified width/setup plus demo availability, but there remains no disclosed test of the seed's 157 standard size. The 157W anecdote is a separate variant of unknown production season.
